title: Laughter
coreMove: Use laughter to identify when people are making danger playable while keeping a retreat route open.
sourcePressure: The source treats laughter as a play signal that softens physical or social danger and preserves deniability in risky interaction.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: The writer makes laughter about happiness or humor quality instead of danger, play, and deniability.

sourceAnchors.name: laughter as a play signal
sourceAnchors.detail: The source says laughter functions as a play signal.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: The laugh tells the room that the bite is not meant to draw blood.

sourceAnchors.name: softening physical and social danger
sourceAnchors.detail: The source says laughter softens physical and social danger.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: A risky move becomes easier to test when laughter wraps the edge.

sourceAnchors.name: deniability in risky interaction
sourceAnchors.detail: The source says laughter preserves deniability around offense, flirtation, or threat.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: If the signal fails, the laugh leaves a door marked only joking.

exampleSpecs.audience: a coach stopping rough teasing from becoming unsafe
exampleSpecs.stakes: jokes are testing hierarchy under physical risk
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: Ben hears Chloe laugh after a bad knot joke and pauses the drill to separate playful fear from real belay uncertainty.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Chalk dust floats in the cone of light above the belay mats.

exampleSpecs.domain: design critique for a fragile prototype
exampleSpecs.audience: a product lead managing teasing around a flawed demo
exampleSpecs.stakes: one laugh can keep critique playable or hide a status jab
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: "It looks like a toaster with a law degree," Lars says, and Isabel watches whether Akira laughs with relief or freezes before continuing critique.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: "It looks like a toaster with a law degree," Lars says as the prototype wobbles.

exampleSpecs.audience: a sibling testing a risky question without making it official
exampleSpecs.stakes: flirtation and offense need a retreat route
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: You hear Anna laugh before asking about the old breakup, then decide whether the laugh softened curiosity or disguised a shove.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: You see the serving spoon pause halfway over the casserole.

exampleSpecs.audience: a facilitator keeping simulated conflict from becoming real threat
exampleSpecs.stakes: laughter can mark the exercise as play without trivializing fear
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: The facilitator lets one shared laugh land after the mock traffic stop, then names the exact line where play would become dismissal.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: Fluorescent tape marks the pretend curb on the gym floor.

exampleSpecs.audience: an HR partner deciding whether a welcome joke is safe
exampleSpecs.stakes: deniability can protect the person taking the shot
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: When does a laugh turn a welcome ritual into a warning?
exampleSpecs.firstImage: When does the laugh belong to the group but not the new hire?

exampleSpecs.audience: a resident using laughter after dropping an instrument
exampleSpecs.stakes: physical danger is simulated but status danger is real
exampleSpecs.requiredBeat: It took Maja one video review to see that her laugh invited help on the first mistake and hid panic on the second.
exampleSpecs.firstImage: It took Maja one video review to hear the two laughs differently.

skillTargets: identify laughter as play signaling rather than joy alone
analyze deniability in risky social moves
choose when to accept, redirect, or stop laughter around danger

tryThisNowSpec: Notice one laugh today after a risky comment. Ask whether it softened play, hid aggression, invited closeness, or kept an escape route open.
